title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: report.tex equations and types.hpp/solver.cpp describe conservative 2-D perfect-gas/Navier–Stokes equations and case viscosity; no independent full physics proof.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp reads CGNS and constructs cell/face geometry; main.cpp:100–114 creates the global mesh on each rank and retains it through solve.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp:250–335 assembles inviscid/viscous face residual with global norms; no independent conservation rerun. Recovered data expose physical convergence limitations.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: solver.cpp:282–297 uses direct wall and Rusanov interior/farfield fluxes; output.cpp:148 correctly labels Rusanov. Previous note incorrectly asserted Roe and referenced nonexistent output.hpp behavior.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: solver.cpp:688–700 explicitly writes no-slip u=v=Mach=0 boundary values; recovered surface data exist, but physical wall convergence is not established by boundary-value semantics.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: solver.cpp:202 suppresses limiter via firstOrderMode/limiterRamp; :579 forces first-order Re200, explicitly disclosed in report.tex:124,192. Steady activation and runtime provenance remain qualified.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth-type bounded limiter and positive-state fallback are implemented; transient limiterRamp=0 disables reconstructed correction, as disclosed; strong steady oscillations remain.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:650–667 integrates full viscous traction, including normal component, instead of required tangential skin-friction split. Surface Cf separately projects tangential traction. Numerical laminar/Re20 results have independent failures.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: LU-SGS source and CFL cap exist; solver.cpp:538–540 unconditionally marks max-step steady results converged, including oscillatory M015/Re20 historical runs.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF2 source and t300 historical package exist, but strict relative-target counting reports 11356 misses in checkpoint stdout while metadata claims zero. Report additionally claims an absolute 1e-10 criterion absent from recorded revision source. Binary hash unverified.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: 5b9dded7 main.cpp:100–102 reads complete mesh on every rank; it remains live through :135–138 solver loops and is reused at :152. This violates TASK.md:46,227 despite METIS/neighbor halos.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
